interface.longDescription:
Create animated bar, line and pie charts with ChatGPT. Use your own data or ask ChatGPT to research a topic and find data for you. You can also start from an example or continue editing an existing RaceCharts project.

The built-in RaceCharts financial tool gives ChatGPT access to a range of financial data for your charts. Explore stock prices, compare company financials, track investment growth and other financial trends using data provided by the financial tool.

Choose portrait, square or landscape format. Change your chart’s title, colors and layout, and add images, music or timeline events. Preview the chart before saving it to RaceCharts, where you can continue editing whenever you like.

When you’re happy with the result, ask ChatGPT to export a video and give you a download link.

You’ll need a RaceCharts account to get started. You choose which projects and actions your assistant can access. Access to financial data and video exports depends on your account’s permissions and available allowances.
defaultPrompt: Compare $10,000 each in NVIDIA and Tesla since 2011, dividends reinvested. Create a portrait line chart. Preview before saving.

prompts: Compare how $10,000 invested in each of NVIDIA (NVDA) and Tesla (TSLA) has grown since 2011, with dividends reinvested. Create a portrait line chart. Show me a preview before saving.
Create a square line chart with a light background, blue and red lines, using the data I provide. Show me a preview before saving.
Make a copy of a RaceCharts example and help me customize its title and colors. Preserve its existing format and show me a preview before saving.

publication.release_notes: Turns editor-only margin guides off by default for newly created charts, including copies and similar-chart requests. Explicit requests for guides still work, and existing charts retain their settings. Chart styles, data, timeline settings, permissions and the existing RaceCharts MCP connection are unchanged.
